INSERT INTO TB_SUBSCRIBE ( SUB_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, SUBS_STATUS, SUBS_START, SUBS_END, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE, PLAN_CODE, CONTRACT_CODE, BILLING_PERIOD, CURRENT_USER_COUNT, CURRENT_PRICE ) VALUES ( #{subCode}, #{companyCode}, #{subsStatus}, #{subsStart}, #{subsEnd}, #{createdBy}, #{createDate}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateDate}, #{planCode}, #{contractCode}, #{billingPeriod}, #{currentUserCount}, #{currentPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT sub_code AS subCode, company_code AS companyCode, plan_code AS planCode, contract_code AS contractCode, subs_status AS subsStatus, subs_start AS subsStart, subs_end AS subsEnd, billing_key AS billingKey, current_price AS currentPrice, recent_billing_date AS recentBillingDate, next_billing_date AS nextBillingDate FROM SUBSCRIBE WHERE sub_code = #{subCode}

SELECT sub_code AS subCode, company_code AS companyCode, plan_code AS planCode, contract_code AS contractCode, subs_status AS subsStatus, subs_start AS subsStart, subs_end AS subsEnd, billing_key AS billingKey, current_price AS currentPrice, recent_billing_date AS recentBillingDate, next_billing_date AS nextBillingDate FROM SUBSCRIBE WHERE subs_status = 'ACTIVE' AND billing_key IS NOT NULL AND next_billing_date = #{today}
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIBE SET recent_billing_date = #{recentBillingDate}, next_billing_date = #{nextBillingDate}, update_date = NOW(), updated_by = 'SYSTEM' WHERE sub_code = #{subCode}
